neighbours.label: Variety or spread within a group: diversity, variation, range, span, assortment, разно- (multicoloured, diverse)
fire: The region is known for the sheer variety of its dialects.
Researchers measured the heterogeneity of the patient sample.
The shop offers a wide assortment of cheeses from every province.
Opinions in the village range from enthusiasm to outright hostility.
The exhibition spans three centuries of portrait painting.
The class is a mix of ages, from teenagers to retirees.
Bird plumage varies widely between the two islands.
quiet: The region is known for the sheer size of its forests.
Researchers measured the weight of each patient sample.
The shop offers the same cheese it has sold for fifty years.
Opinions in the village are unanimous in favour of the plan.
The exhibition opened three weeks ago in the main hall.
The class is made up entirely of teenagers.
Bird plumage is identical on the two islands.

predictions: Sentences asserting variety, range or spread within a set reach 0.35-0.8, peaking on the variety noun or verb (variety, heterogeneity, assortment, range, spans, разнообразными, mix, varies). Twins asserting size, weight, sameness, unanimity or a single kind stay under 0.15.
notes: Probe: разноцветных 0.807 (peak 'но'), genetic diversity 0.644, span of eighty years 0.514, variety within Buddhism 0.412, natural variations 0.388; 'genetic makeup' 0.142, uniform marble 0.021, single decade 0.013, population size 0.016, floor 0.017. Card: ' diversity' x7, 'но' x7 (раз|но|образная), ' variation', ' span', ' around' (max 43.5, layer 26); the - pole's output suppresses vary/varies/variation/fluct, so the pair is a variety-versus-constancy axis.
